sourceTraceSupplement.text: An explicitly activated read-error retry keeps its action and error explanation visible even when the query resets to Loading. Show Retrying and an accessible busy state, keep keyboard focus, ignore repeat activation, and keep unrelated recovery actions usable. Failure restores Try again. After success, move focus to that screen’s relevant result, control or heading only if the same retry still owns focus. Tab, pointer activity, navigation, resource changes, a new overlay or window hiding cancel this focus handoff while the read continues. A retry inside a dialog or popover stays within that same still-open overlay. Initial loads and background refreshes do not arm a focus handoff. A compound playlist refresh stays busy through both its detail and playlist-list reads; a failure in either keeps an actionable retry. Changing the search or resource leaves the obsolete retry behind and keeps the new resource's retry usable. Retry starts only the stated read operation and cannot submit a form. Existing page-specific focus handoffs still apply when recovery removes an error.
